canonical_units.canonical_label: Проверяемая безударная гласная в корне: выбор проверочного слова или формы с ударением
canonical_units.decision_model: If the unstressed root vowel is verifiable, choose a cognate/form in which the same root vowel is stressed; reject false phonetic lookalikes and invalid aspectual -ывать/-ивать checks where the academic rule excludes them.
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: Does not own alternating-root rules or dictionary-unverifiable roots.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Непроверяемая безударная гласная в корне: словарная проверка
canonical_units.decision_model: When the root vowel cannot be established by a valid stressed cognate/form and is not governed by a special alternating-root rule, spelling is dictionary-controlled.
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: Not a memorized list identity; individual lexical items may be exercise members without becoming denominator units.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Гласные после шипящих в корне: базовый выбор и проверяемое Ё/Е против словарного О
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: school-o-after-sibilants-lexical-o-set retains its memorized lexical O members; school-zhog-zheg-part-of-speech-contrast retains noun/verb -ЖОГ-/-ЖЁГ-. Those identities are not duplicated here.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Гласные после Ц в корне: базовое написание И/О и граница с традиционной группой ЦЫ
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: school-tsy-exception-family remains the counted lexical exception family; this unit owns the productive base decision and route to that exception set, not the exception members themselves.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Парная звонкая/глухая согласная в корне: проверка сильной позицией
canonical_units.decision_model: Verify a doubtful root consonant with a form/cognate where the consonant is followed by a vowel or another position that makes the consonant identity clear; dictionary-control nonverifiable cases remain separate.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Непроизносимая согласная в корне: проверка формой или однокоренным словом
canonical_units.decision_model: For a doubtful consonant in a consonant cluster, use a form/cognate that reveals the consonant before a vowel; lexical nonverifiable spellings remain dictionary-controlled.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Разделительные Ъ и Ь: выбор знака по морфемной позиции
structured_branches: Ъ after consonant-ending prefix/defined first component before е ё ю я
Ь in internal non-prefix separating position before е ё и ю я and specified borrowed patterns

canonical_units.canonical_label: Приставки на З/С и неизменяемая приставка С-
canonical_units.decision_model: For prefixes with z/s alternation choose S before a voiceless consonant and Z otherwise under the academic rule; distinguish the invariant prefix С- and root-initial З in words where no such prefix exists.

canonical_units.canonical_label: ПРЕ- / ПРИ-: базовый смысловой выбор приставки
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: school-pre-pri-lexical-contrast-family retains lexicalized/homophonic contrast pairs where productive semantic decoding is insufficient.

canonical_units.canonical_label: И / Ы после приставок: базовое изменение И→Ы после русской приставки на согласную
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: school-i-y-after-prefix-vzimat-exception retains ВЗИМАТЬ; school-i-y-after-prefix-retain-i-boundary retains contexts where initial И is preserved after specified prefixes/components.

canonical_units.canonical_label: О / Е(Ё) после шипящих в суффиксах и окончаниях
canonical_units.ownership_boundary: Root spelling after sibilants belongs to school-root-o-yo-after-sibilants-base and its lexical special units, not here.

canonical_units.canonical_label: Гласные после Ц в суффиксах и окончаниях
canonical_units.decision_model: Use the suffix/ending rules for stressed O vs unstressed E and the normative Ы writing in the relevant suffixes/endings; distinguish root spelling after Ц.
